KALOLENI CLINKER PLANT SET IN A
BIODIVERSITY ENVIRONMENT
The 1,500 tons per day clinker plant, surrounded
by thousands of trees and a 3 acre tilapia filled
dam, has become home to many species of birds.
ARM is actively promoting biodiversity at its
operations, and focuses on tree planting, not only
at the plants and quarries, but also in the
surrounding communities.
The company has twice been awarded the
highest award by Total Eco Challenge for its work
in environmental and tree planting activities in
the country.
